## Goal
Add an OKF-like disclosure export path that turns Open Brain lanes/facts/receipts into progressive disclosure bundles without changing OB storage.

## Scope
- Export index.md, scoped log.md, concept markdown files, citations, and receipt appendices.
- Use metadata.okf and interchange_profiles.okf as compatibility hooks.
- Preserve unknown OKF metadata keys.
- Treat import as staging only; do not auto-promote imported content.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Exporter produces a deterministic disclosure bundle from a sample lane.
- Citations are generated from source_ref, artifact_path, repo fact source URLs, and receipts.
- Docs state OKF is an edge profile, not the storage model.

Target date: 2026-06-28.
